pages.title: Without the Nether
pages.text: The Nether is severed in Phase 5. If you never fought a blaze, you can still build a Thermal Core, a rocket engine, reinforced armor and Hot Wings. The substitutes cost more and take you to vents and cold groves instead.$(br2)Frozen Dawn recipes that call for blaze powder accept a $(bold)Sulfur Igniter$(); those that call for magma cream accept a $(bold)Thermal Binder$().
Four sulfur and one coal. Sulfur comes from sulfur ore and from the Fuel Processing Silo.
Two sulfur and two Rimewood Resin: a deep vent resource and a cold surface one.
